title: Broom-handle posture check
headline: The broom-handle posture check
caption:
Ever wondered how straight your back really is? 🧹

In class we sometimes use a long pole to check alignment. At home, a broom handle does the same job.

Try it:

1. Stand tall and hold the handle upright behind you, one hand behind your neck and one at the small of your back.
2. Let it touch three points: the back of your head, between your shoulder blades and your tailbone.
3. Breathe slowly. If your head pokes forward or your lower back arches away, gently draw back until all three points touch.

Keep it relaxed, with no forcing, and stop if anything feels painful.

Tomorrow is International Men's Day, and this check works for every body, especially after long days at a desk or behind the wheel.

We build this kind of everyday strength and awareness in reformer Pilates in the Ribble Valley.

Save this for your next posture check 📌
